svg.text: Dottie Docket in the Ask Dottie thinking spinner. One stride, 720 ms: left hind with right fore, then right hind with left fore; all four feet up in phases 4 and 8.
One square is one pixel of the 56 px spinner; heavier lines every 5. The grid is fixed to the ground and moves back 2 squares a phase as she runs, so a planted foot keeps its square.
Far-side (right) legs are drawn darker. Drawn from the spinner’s own frames (src/features/ask/dottie.js) by tools/ask/dottie-sheet.mjs.
